units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 12:1:11">Y. Yeb. XII, 12ᶜ</cite>, a. e. <he>ה׳</he>, or <he>הַתָּרַת הרצועות</he> the untying of the shoe strings by the brother’s wife, v. <cite ref="H01060"><he>חֲלִיצָה</he></cite>. Sot. I, 16ᶜ bot. <he>ה׳ הסינר</he> loosening of the pantaloons; a. e.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 17:1:3">Y. Sabb. XVII, 16ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>קודם להַתָּרַת כלים</he> prior to the passage of the law permitting the handling of tools on the Sabbath (Mish. ib. XVII, 1); Bab.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 58b:13">Snh. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>מאימת הַתָּרָתָהּ</he> when is she again considered free?
